others.name: TechLiving Hub Solutions Corporation

lockup.summary: Directors, officers and all current shareholders, including six pre-IPO investors, agreed not to sell shares for 180 days after the offering closes. The company has agreed to the same restriction on issuing shares.

what: It rents student dormitories near Hong Kong universities and refers students to education advisory services under the Student Living brand.
proceeds: It plans to use about 55% for growing its Hong Kong business and 20% to expand into Southeast Asia. About 5% is for its dormitory management system and 20% for working capital and general costs.
risks: Most customers are students who use the service only once, so the company must keep finding new students every year.
The company has a short operating history, so its past growth may not predict future results.
The company depends on its management, especially Mr. Chun Kwok Ng, and has no key man insurance.
All education referral revenue comes from one partner, Meta Academia, and either side can end the deal with one month's notice.
Meta Academia is a related party, so its deals may not be on terms an unrelated party would get.
